edits:
code_oss:
    name: Build embedded native workbench
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.platform == 'mac' && (inputs.arch == 'x64' && 'macos-15-intel' || 'macos-15') || inputs.platform == 'win' && 'windows-2025' || (inputs.arch == 'arm64' && 'ubuntu-24.04-arm' || 'ubuntu-24.04') }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.source_commit }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-code-oss
        with:
          flavor: ${{ inputs.desktop_flavor }}
          arch: ${{ inputs.arch }}
      - name: Archive native resources with executable modes
        shell: bash
        run: tar -czf code-oss-runtime.tar.gz -C .code-oss runtime
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: code-oss-runtime-${{ inputs.platform }}-${{ inputs.arch }}
          path: code-oss-runtime.tar.gz
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error

    needs: code_oss

      - name: Import native workbench resources
        if: steps.restore_checkpoint.outcome != 'success'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: code-oss-runtime-${{ inputs.platform }}-${{ inputs.arch }}
          path: .code-oss

      - name: Restore native resource permissions
        if: steps.restore_checkpoint.outcome != 'success'
        shell: bash
        run: tar -xzf .code-oss/code-oss-runtime.tar.gz -C .code-oss

# Pinned native Code-OSS source/build resources, never another application.
/.code-oss/

"clean": "rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules scripts/node_modules apps/*/dist apps/*/dist-electron packages/*/dist .turbo apps/*/.turbo packages/*/.turbo",
    "code-oss:prepare": "node apps/desktop/code-oss/scripts/prepare.mjs",
    "code-oss:build": "node apps/desktop/code-oss/scripts/build.mjs"
